Role Description

Lead Databricks Developer (Offshore) Looking for 2 strong Lead Databricks Developers with streaming expertise. Key Responsibilities

• Design and develop end-to-end data pipelines using Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake).
• Build real-time streaming ingestion pipelines from Kafka and other event-driven sources.
• Implement layered data architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) to support transformation and reporting. Develop data processing logic for transactional data ingestion, validation, and enrichment. Apply data quality, deduplication, and business rules for healthcare datasets.
• Support cloud migration from on-premise systems to Databricks + Snowflake ecosystem. Optimize pipeline performance to meet SLA-driven processing timelines. Implement and support CI/CD pipelines and DevOps integration. Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions. Required Skills
• Strong expertise in Databricks (Streaming & Batch) Advanced proficiency in PySpark / Spark SQL/Spark Streaming
• Experience in real-time data streaming (Kafka) Strong understanding of data modeling and ETL/ELT pipeline design
• Hands-on experience with AWS (S3, Airflow, Lambda) Experience with CI/CD, Git, and deployment automation Domain Experience
• Experience in Healthcare Payer domain (Claims, Membership, Coverage) Exposure to FHIR / healthcare data standards preferred Understanding of data privacy, security, and governance requirements (PII/HIPAA) Leadership Expectations
• Operate at a Lead level driving design, development, and delivery Mentor team members and ensure delivery quality Own modules independently and collaborate across distributed teams Experience
• 8+ years in Data Engineering
• 3+ years hands-on experience with Databricks Prior experience in Tech Lead/Senior roles Looking for 2 strong Lead Databricks Developers with streaming expertise

Skills

Apache Spark, PySpark, Databricks, Apache Kafka

Job Summary

 JOB DESCRIPTION 

A Principal Consultant Client Services at Argano plays a crucial role in shaping the direction of the Client Services family. They are responsible for managing and enhancing relationships with mid-to-large clients to ensure their satisfaction, retention, and continued business with the company. They are involved in setting strategic goals, leading mid to large size client initiatives, and providing expert guidance to both clients and internal teams and providing advanced technical support and configurations when requested. They act as a bridge between the client and Argano, ensuring that client needs are understood and met. A Principal Consultant is constantly implementing and testing enhancements as well as new functionality. This position requires module expertise in Oracle HCM Benefits and either Workforce Compensation or Recruiting. Additional modules are a plus. 

Responsibilities

• Maintain regular communication with mid to large size clients to understand their needs, concerns, and feedback. Respond promptly to client inquiries and resolve issues in a timely manner.
• Align existing client practices and procedures with validated HCM Cloud methods to solve client needs and challenges.
• Troubleshoot issues.
• Propose a best practice solution to resolve challenges.
• Identify business requirements and map them to the Oracle Cloud functionality.
• Identify functionality gaps and develop solutions to them, through process or design.
• Configure the Oracle Cloud to meet client requirements and document application set-ups.
• Analyze and resolve functionality issues as well as proactively identifying long-term solutions.
• Lead and present to clients and internally
• Advise clients on options, risks and any impacts on other processes and/or systems.
• Manage scope and client expectations on individual assignments and in day-to-day activities.
• Lead and support clients with the execution of test scripts.
• Participate in internal forums for training, teamwork, issue resolution and innovative design.
• Provide knowledge transfer to clients.
• Create specification documents for technical object development.
• Be leaders with a vision in the Oracle Cloud space with innovative solutions around the product.
• Constant Implementation and testing of advanced enhancements as well as new functionality.
• Manage and oversee client accounts, including contract renewals, upselling, and cross-selling products or services.
• Develop account plans to maximize value for both the client and Argano.
• Focuses on maintenance, reconfiguration, new functionality or modules.
• Ensure high levels of client satisfaction by delivering exceptional client service and addressing any client issues or complaints.
• Collaborate with clients to understand their business goals and objectives. Provide strategic insights and recommendations to help clients achieve their goals through the company's products or services.
• Work closely with internal sales, marketing, Project managers, etc. to align client needs with Argano’s offerings.
• Prepare and present regular reports to management and clients, outlining key performance metrics and the status of client accounts.

Education

MINIMUM AND/OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Finance, Engineering, etc.) expected.

Experience

• 5 - 10 years of Managed Services experience in Multi Client environment.
• Module-specific experience in Benefits and either Workforce Compensation or Recruiting. 
• Demonstrated experience in understanding business practice concepts in your modules of expertise.
• Track record of building long-lasting relationships with your clients
• Bachelor’s Degree preferred.
• 3 full life cycle Oracle HCM Cloud implementations
• Ability to understand fundamental system design and purpose.
• Ability to engage effectively at the business and technical level.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Oracle certified in your modules of expertise.
• Ability to manage/deliver projects, including experience planning and estimating.
• Validated ability to support sales as Subject Matter Expert
• Strong interpersonal skills
• Knowledge of challenges commonly faced by client and support teams.
• Ability to work well autonomously and in a team environment.
• Ability to effectively manage priorities and multiple clients.
• Self-motivated and able to plan work effort and manage priorities.
• Experience Leading and managing mid-size client projects independently.
• Experience providing complex solutions to clients.
• Proven track record of successful project management and client satisfaction.

About Us

Argano is the first of its kind: a digital consultancy totally immersed in high-performance operations. We steward enterprises through ever-evolving markets, empowering them with transformative strategies and technologies to exceed customer expectations, unlock commercial innovation, and drive optimal efficiency and growth.

Argano is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.
